scheme_name: Scholarship for C.G. Domicile Students Pursuing Engineering Courses Outside Chhattisgarh State
description:
The Scholarship for C.G. Domicile Students Pursuing Engineering Courses Outside Chhattisgarh State is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Chhattisgarh.

This scheme was launched in the year 2017 to support students from Chhattisgarh who wish to pursue engineering courses outside the state.

The primary objective of this scholarship is to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students.

The scheme aims to ensure that students from Chhattisgarh can access quality education in engineering institutions across India.

The scholarship covers tuition fees and other related expenses for eligible students.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is up to INR 1,00,000 per year.

This amount is intended to cover the cost of tuition fees as well as other academic expenses.

The scholarship is applicable for the entire duration of the engineering course, which typically spans four years.

To be eligible for this scholarship, students must be domiciles of Chhattisgarh.

Students must have completed their higher secondary education from a recognized board.

The income limit for the family of the applicant is set at INR 6,00,000 per annum.

This income criterion is aimed at targeting economically weaker sections of society.

Students must also have secured admission to a recognized engineering institution outside Chhattisgarh.

The admission must be based on merit through national or state-level entrance examinations.

Eligible entrance examinations include JEE Main and other recognized tests.

The application process for the scholarship is conducted online through the official website of the Chhattisgarh government.

Students must visit the website and register themselves to access the application form.

The application form requires personal details such as name, address, and contact information.

Students must also provide details of their educational qualifications and the engineering institution they have been admitted to.

Documents required for the application include a domicile certificate of Chhattisgarh.

Students must also submit their family income certificate issued by a competent authority.

A copy of the admission letter from the engineering institution is also necessary.

Additionally, students must provide their academic certificates from the higher secondary level.

The completed application form along with the required documents must be submitted online.

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set at the beginning of the academic year.

Students are advised to keep track of the official notifications for specific dates.

Once the applications are submitted, they are reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The disbursement of the scholarship amount is typically done in two installments each academic year.

The first installment is released at the beginning of the academic year.

The second installment is released after the completion of the first semester.

Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75 percent to be eligible for the second installment.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Technical Education, Chhattisgarh.

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds.

Students can contact the department for any queries related to the scholarship.

The contact details for the Department of Technical Education can be found on the official Chhattisgarh government website.

The scholarship scheme has significantly benefited students from Chhattisgarh.

It has enabled many students to pursue their dreams of obtaining an engineering degree.

The scheme has also contributed to reducing the financial burden on families.

In recent years, the number of beneficiaries has increased substantially.

In the academic year 2020-2021, over 2,500 students received the scholarship.

The government allocated a budget of INR 25 crores for this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022.

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to promoting higher education among students.

The scholarship has also been instrumental in improving the enrollment rates of Chhattisgarh students in engineering colleges.

Students who have availed of this scholarship have reported positive experiences.

Many have expressed gratitude for the financial support provided.

The scheme has also encouraged students to excel academically.

It has fostered a competitive spirit among students from Chhattisgarh.

The scholarship is part of a broader initiative by the Chhattisgarh government to enhance educational opportunities.

The government aims to create a skilled workforce to meet the demands of various industries.

The scheme aligns with the national goal of promoting technical education in India.

It is a step towards bridging the gap between urban and rural education.

The scholarship has also been praised for its transparency in the application process.

Students can track the status of their applications online.

This feature has enhanced the trust of students in the government’s initiatives.

The scholarship for C.G. domicile students pursuing engineering courses outside Chhattisgarh is a vital program.

It plays a crucial role in empowering students through education.

The scheme reflects the government's dedication to fostering talent and innovation.

It is an essential tool for socio-economic development in the state.

The scholarship is expected to continue evolving to meet the needs of students.

The government is likely to expand its reach and increase the financial assistance offered.

This initiative is a testament to the importance of education in shaping the future of the youth in Chhattisgarh.
